svg.title: The same perfect score from two very different models
svg.desc: On the original 200-row split, the fine-tuned Llama model and a depth-2 decision tree both achieve 100 percent accuracy. The synthetic label is determined by two input fields. The scores do not demonstrate real delay prediction, and the historical split is not a clean independent test set.

g.text: Accuracy on the same historical 200-row split
Label leakage · Neither score demonstrates real delay prediction
